notes.title: Alpha version of Skeleboy is now live!
notes.notes:
ALPHA TESTING IS NOW LIVE
People say it's never too early for developers to playtest a game. Since I've been at this for about 15 months, I'd say it's about time. Feel free to try out the first world in Skeleboy, and let me know what you think! Send comments in-game by pressing T.

I know it's more of a beta, since I'm opening it up to unknown players but it is the same version I used for in-house testing. (friends and family lol)



Download the game here!



Known bugs:

Rare paints are too common as rewards.

A road may be drawn between stages you haven't reached.

It is possible to slip through the obsticles when fighting The Howling One.

The game will softlock if you, in some way, beat Hypnox or Gullveig.
